text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days have passed since the five
chosen students began
practicing for the
Heartfire Ceremony.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
All right, today we'll take it from the top
and do it once through, see
what we all
need to work on.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
But first, Oguri! The Rites of Entwinement
and Procession—how many
parts are they
each split into? Go!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Umm... The Entwinement has four,
and the Procession just one...
I think.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ding, ding, ding! Glad to see there's no
need for one of my quips.
Right then, let's
start with a refresher on the Entwinement.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
In the first part of the Entwinement, ya
face the sole slate bonfire and
do a slooow
dance, then use the flame to light your
torch.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
In the second part, the Bearer takes their
torch and runs all the way
up the mountain
to the Ring, carryin' the flame with them.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Then when they get there, the Bearer does
a lively dance with torch
in hand, all while
runnin' 'round the Ring and yellin' at the
top of their
lungs.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: You gotta scream, dance, and run around at the same time with all of your energy—it's gonna do a number on ya!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
So today, we're gonna tackle the second
part, startin' from when we
run 'round the
Ring!

text_block_list.name: Inari & Tamamo
text_block_list.text: HAHHHHH!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Tama and Inari are really something. I
don't know how they can yell
so loud while
running.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
And not only that—the fierce dance seems
to be no trouble at all for
them either.
That takes impressive stamina and
athleticism!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Phew! This is killer, but at least you get to
improvise a little and go
wild. Don't gotta
worry about messin' up like with the first
dance.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! And you really know how to go
wild, don'tcha? Well, not
enough to
one-up me, though!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You talkin' down to me? Bring it on!
Next group practice, I'm
gonna upstage
you big time!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...I have much to learn from the way you
two give voice to passion.
This part is
surely my biggest weakness, so I must
redouble my efforts.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I guess screamin' bloody murder
doesn't really fit your image.
But y'know,
I've been hearin' a lot more outta you
compared to when
we started, so keep at
it!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
If anything, Yaeno, I woulda expected you
to have this part in the
bag, but...
Somethin' the matter? I know you got
more volume and
energy in you.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I... My apologies. I will practice hard until I
am on the same level as
you two.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you're a cut above when it comes to
the slow ritual dance in the
first half! For
now, how 'bout you get the rest of us up
to speed on
that one?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...I'll do my best.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
All right, now we're gonna practice the
third part of the Entwinement.
Here's
where the mood takes another 180.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
After rompin' 'round the Ring, you take
your torch to the altar in the
middle and
transfer the flame to the brazier there,
then swap out with
the next Bearer.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Now after that comes the Dedication, a
document to honor the wishes
of runners
from the past—with a whole lotta stuffy
language you gotta
read out loud.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"We are gathered here... before our
forerunners... to offer these our

felicitations?" Uhh...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"From past to present, present to future...
those who run a path known
to none..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Those multitude who have passed before.
We here entwine them all
to illuminate,
praise, console, ignite anew, and to spark
a flame that
shall be our guide."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...Well, this is one thing I can't give Tama
and Oguri a hard time
about. Like c'mon,
these characters got so many strokes, I'm
gonna
have one of my own!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Ardan here can already recite
it from memory. And with
beautiful
enunciation, at that.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
O-oh, crap! I can see da steam comin'
outta Oguri's noggin again!
Ardan, lay off
it for a sec!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...S-sorry, it feels like I had you write down
all those definitions and
pronunciation
notes for nothing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Nonsense. Your reading has already
improved markedly—just take it
one word
at a time. I'll help you get there.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thanks... You'd make a good teacher, you
know.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Well, thank the Goddesses we have Ardan
with us. Imagine if it was
just us pea
brains...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Next up is the fourth part of the
Entwinement, then we're gonna start

practicin' for the other rite, the Procession.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
After readin' the Dedication, the Bearer
takes a special flower
arrangement meant
to bring good luck and tosses it from the
altar,
spreadin' the fortune.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Once the fourth part's done, that's it for
the Entwinement. Then it's
time for the
next rite, the Procession.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
There's only one thing to do in this one.
It's real simple!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I like the Procession. Just a fun
sprint from the Ring down the
mountain.
It's basically a race.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, we're just scopin' out the course
and ya take off at full speed?
Thanks to
you, I had to put some fire in my step, ya
nitwit!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Seconded. You basically had us doing
partner runs... Though I'm not
sure what
else we were expecting from you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...I don't foresee us having any trouble with
the Procession. In fact, it
seems
everybody's enjoying themselves much
more compared to the
other parts.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Got that right. Anyone who runs with
Oguri ends up like this—she just
has that
effect on people, dunno what it is.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
But we can't rest easy—the Entwinement's
gonna be a problem. All
the parts had
some major issues we gotta work on.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
The midterm rehearsal is already just
around the corner... I fear we
can only
improve so much between now and then.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Sorry I keep messing up on so much of it.
Feels like I'm just dragging
the team down
at this point.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Nope, 'nuff of that! I get why you're
nervous. I make plenty of
mistakes myself,
and we don't got much time to practice.
But you
know what?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Right now, we're a team. We're not goin'
at it alone, which means we
can play to
our strengths and cover each other's
weaknesses. So let's
hunker down and do
this!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You said it, boss! Got us all on the same
page, just like that! Now
that's style!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't have said it better myself. To
fulfill our duties as Bearers,
we must come
together as a team and devote ourselves
to practice!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hear, hear! We gotta come together... as a
team. And teams... wait a
sec...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That's it! I got an idea! All right, hear me
out...
